mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS<=0.5% periods are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or positive return rate <55%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225.0) signals potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL>225.0 (p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and weak labor market conditions (PAYEMS < 132000 thousand) signal an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE>9.0 AND PAYEMS<132000 (p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Weak economic activity (INDPRO < 90.0) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a recessionary regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO<90.0 AND UNRATE>9.0 (p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 560.0) signal strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in HOUST>560.0 periods or positive return rate <55%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225.0) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL>225.0 (p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 94.0) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in INDPRO>94.0 periods or positive return rate <55%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE>9.0 (p>0.05 for negative returns).
